items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: Well, you take guys like Lionel, he was considered a rabble rouser... I thought that Lionel had a problem.

ctx.x: We've spoken as to how the community felt about some of the musicians; what was the attitude of some musicians towards their peers, the stronger, more proficient players; how did some of the less skilled musicians look at them, and vice-versa?
Well, you take guys like Lionel, he was considered a rabble rouser. You'd see him around with some of
the lesser known musicians. He wasn't particular about who he ran with.
